<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/customer-order">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Quote" name="Quote"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Approval" name="Customer approval"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CustomerOrder">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Potential customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Business" name="Business" processRef="Process_CustomerOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Inquiry" name="Inquiry"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Inquiry"
                      messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Quote" name="Quote"
                      sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Participant_Customer"
                      messageRef="Message_Quote"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Approval" name="Approval"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApproval"
                      messageRef="Message_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Order confirmation"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"
                      messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CustomerOrder" name="Customer order process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_CustomerOrder">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesSupport" name="Sales staff or customer support">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Inquiry</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddressConcerns</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CustomerInterested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_NotInterested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SalesRepresentative" name="Sales representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GuideSelection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideQuote</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveApproval</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlaceOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderConfirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Inquiry" name="Product or service inquiry received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Inquiry" messageRef="Message_Inquiry"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInformation" name="Collect relevant information"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddressConcerns" name="Address concerns and questions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerInterested" name="Customer interested?" default="Flow_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuideSelection" name="Guide product or service selection"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideQuote" name="Provide quote" messageRef="Message_Quote"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveApproval" name="Receive customer approval" messageRef="Message_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record order in the system"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotInterested" name="Customer not interested"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed" name="Order placed and confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inquiry_Collect" sourceRef="StartEvent_Inquiry" targetRef="Task_CollectInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Address" sourceRef="Task_CollectInformation" targetRef="Task_AddressConcerns"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Address_Interest" sourceRef="Task_AddressConcerns" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Interested" name="Interested" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerInterested" targetRef="Task_GuideSelection">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${customerInterested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInterested" name="Not interested" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerInterested" targetRef="EndEvent_NotInterested"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guide_Quote" sourceRef="Task_GuideSelection" targetRef="Task_ProvideQuote"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Quote_Approval" sourceRef="Task_ProvideQuote" targetRef="Task_ReceiveApproval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_Place" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveApproval" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Place_Record" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_Confirmation" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_End" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
